info.name: EventZone API
info.description: Run the folders in order (or the whole collection with the Collection Runner / newman). Start the backend first. Demo accounts (local seed data only): admin@eventzone.com, org1@eventzone.com, user1@eventzone.com, password Password@123. Tokens and ids are stored in collection variables by the test scripts.

exec: pm.test('New accounts are always ATTENDEE and no password is returned', () => { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('ATTENDEE'); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property('password'); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); });

request.description: Creates a new attendee. The email is generated per run.

exec: pm.test('Error format', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.error).to.eql('CONFLICT'); pm.expect(b.path).to.eql('/api/auth/register'); });
pm.test('Returns a token and the expected user', () => { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.user.email).to.eql('user1@eventzone.com'); });
pm.test('Returns a token and the expected user', () => { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.user.email).to.eql('org1@eventzone.com'); });
pm.test('Returns a token and the expected user', () => { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.user.email).to.eql('admin@eventzone.com'); });

request.description: Tokens are stateless; the client discards its token.

exec: pm.test('At least 5 seeded events with title, category, date and image', () => { pm.expect(events.length).to.be.at.least(5); events.forEach(e => { pm.expect(e.title).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(e.category).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(e.eventDate).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(e.coverImageUrl).to.be.a('string'); }); });
pm.test('Only Sports events', () => { const events = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(events.length).to.be.above(0); events.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.category).to.eql('Sports')); });
pm.test('Contains the seeded categories', () => { const names = cats.map(c => c.name); pm.expect(names).to.include.members(['Concert', 'Sports', 'Workshop']); });

pm.test('Has description and ticket categories with seats', () => { pm.expect(ev.description).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(ev.ticketCategories.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(ev.ticketCategories[0].availableSeats).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('Confirmed booking with reference and total', () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('CONFIRMED'); pm.expect(b.quantity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.bookingRef).to.match(/^EZ-[A-Z2-9]{8}$/); pm.expect(b.totalAmount).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('availableSeats decreased by the booked quantity', () => { const seats = pm.response.json().ticketCategories.find(t => t.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('ticketCategoryId')).availableSeats; pm.expect(seats).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('seatsBefore')) - 2); });

pm.test('availableSeats back to the original value', () => { const seats = pm.response.json().ticketCategories.find(t => t.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('ticketCategoryId')).availableSeats; pm.expect(seats).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('seatsBefore'))); });

request.description: Another user's booking is reported as not found so ids are not leaked.

exec: pm.test('Created, active and without tickets yet', () => { pm.expect(ev.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(ev.ticketCategories).to.have.length(0); });

item.name: New event is in the public catalog

exec: pm.test('Full availability and no bookings', () => { pm.expect(t.availableSeats).to.eql(20); pm.expect(t.bookedSeats).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Total and available seats adjusted together', () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.totalSeats).to.eql(30); pm.expect(t.availableSeats).to.eql(30); });

pm.test('Includes the event with ticket figures', () => { const ev = pm.response.json().find(e => e.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('createdEventId')); pm.expect(ev).to.exist; pm.expect(ev.ticketCategories[0]).to.include.keys('bookedSeats', 'bookingCount', 'availableSeats'); });
pm.test('Includes organiser and status', () => { const evs = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(evs.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(evs[0]).to.include.keys('organiser', 'active'); });
